capability.description: Evaluate whether required evidence survives from selected context packet to final delivered context under deterministic composition and pressure.
known_failure_modes: required fact truncated after successful retrieval
authority or provenance labels lost in composition

experience.statement: Retrieval success is not sufficient evidence that required information reached the consuming model; evaluate final delivered context separately when composition, truncation, or competing payloads can alter the packet.

known_failures: Using an LLM judge for deterministic survival checks.
Treating one consumer's context policy as universal.
procedure.name: delivered-context-fitness-evaluation
trigger_conditions: A context packet can be recomposed, truncated, or mixed with variable external payload before model consumption.

alternative_explanations: DevOS packet budgets are already conservative enough that downstream loss is negligible.
Consumer-side context composition is outside DevOS control and cannot be tested portably.
reflection.expected_behavior: Measure selected-packet correctness and final-delivery correctness as distinct stages when a deterministic consumer adapter exists.
reflection.mechanism_hypothesis: A bounded packet can be correct at retrieval time yet lose required evidence during later ordering, composition, cutoff, duplication, or payload competition.
reflection.predicted_consequence: Held-out delivery fixtures will expose failures that retrieval-only tests report as passes if downstream composition materially alters context.
reflection.required_disconfirmation_test: Use held-out tasks whose DevOS packet contains all required fields across multiple deterministic delivery adapters and pressure levels; close as NO_OP if required evidence, freshness, and provenance always survive without material margin failures.

sources.observation_question: Does agi-memory already distinguish retrieval from actionability and preserve supersession/origin/rationale state?
sources.value: agi-memory already measures retrieval and actionability separately and implements supersession pointers, rationale, origin labels, probe hygiene, and deterministic offline evaluation.

sources.observation_question: Does a memory benchmark measure the final text delivered after context composition and cutoff?
sources.value: adebench measures client-delivered text at a declared door, including context budget, margin, duplicate text, and payload pressure.

sources.observation_question: What evaluation and governance machinery already exists in DevOS?
sources.value: DevOS already has bounded packets, evidence lineage, reflection, transfer/regression evaluation, and governed promotion; the observed delta is evaluative rather than a new memory subsystem.

capability.description: Prefer metadata derived or enforced by deterministic runtime paths when missing metadata would affect safety or future decisions.
known_failure_modes: optional metadata fields remain empty in real use
agent-supplied trust labels become inflated or inconsistent

experience.statement: Do not rely on agent diligence for metadata that materially affects safety, lifecycle, or authority interpretation when the runtime can derive or enforce it structurally.

known_failures: Adding another optional field after prior advisory fields show near-zero adoption.
Inferring authority that the runtime cannot actually determine.
procedure.name: structural-metadata-admission
trigger_conditions: A proposed metadata field changes retrieval, safety, authority, or lifecycle behavior.

alternative_explanations: agi-memory's low adoption is specific to its current assistants and does not transfer to DevOS.
Better tool descriptions could materially increase agent compliance without structural enforcement.
reflection.expected_behavior: Before adding important metadata, determine whether a code path can set or enforce it without relying on agent cooperation.
reflection.mechanism_hypothesis: Optional agent-volunteered metadata has poor real-world completion while runtime-derived metadata is populated consistently because it does not depend on model diligence.
reflection.predicted_consequence: DevOS changes that derive/enforce critical metadata will produce higher completeness and fewer ambiguous records than equivalent advisory-only fields.
reflection.required_disconfirmation_test: On held-out DevOS tasks, compare completion and correctness of one advisory-only field with one runtime-derived/enforced field; revise if advisory completion is comparable without filler or false claims.

sources.observation_question: How often were optional rationale/supersession fields populated in a real vault compared with code-derived origin metadata?
sources.value: In the maintainer's measured real vault, optional rationale and supersession metadata were almost unused, while code-set origins were populated reliably.

sources.observation_question: What evidence threshold should govern reusable DevOS lessons?
sources.value: DevOS requires evidence-backed reflection, held-out transfer, regression evaluation, and governed promotion before candidate lessons become durable authority.
